question: What is my CGPA?
gold_sql: SELECT cgpa FROM my_results ORDER BY semester DESC LIMIT 1

question: How much fee is pending in total?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(pending) AS pending FROM my_fees

question: What is my attendance percentage in DBMS?
gold_sql: SELECT attendance_percent FROM my_attendance WHERE subject_name LIKE '%Database%'

question: When is my next exam and in which subject?
gold_sql: SELECT subject_name, exam_date FROM my_exams WHERE exam_date >= '2026-11-11' ORDER BY exam_date LIMIT 1

question: Which hostel and room am I in?
gold_sql: SELECT hostel_name, room_no FROM my_hostel WHERE to_date IS NULL

question: Show my semester-wise SGPA in order.
gold_sql: SELECT semester, sgpa FROM my_results ORDER BY semester

question: How many classes can I skip in Operating Systems and stay above 75%?
gold_sql: SELECT can_skip FROM my_attendance WHERE subject_name LIKE '%Operating%'

question: What's the status of my complaints?
gold_sql: SELECT status FROM my_complaints

question: Mera CGPA kitna hai?
gold_sql: SELECT cgpa FROM my_results ORDER BY semester DESC LIMIT 1

question: Meri kitni fees pending hai total?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(pending) AS pending FROM my_fees

question: DBMS mein mere total internal marks kitne hain?
gold_sql: SELECT internal_obtained FROM my_marks WHERE subject_name LIKE '%Database%'

question: In which subjects is my attendance below 75%?
gold_sql: SELECT subject_name FROM my_attendance WHERE attendance_percent < 75

question: Meri sabse kam attendance kis subject mein hai?
gold_sql: SELECT subject_name FROM my_attendance ORDER BY attendance_percent LIMIT 1

question: Which students in my OS class are below 75% attendance? Give roll numbers.
gold_sql: SELECT roll_no FROM my_class_attendance WHERE subject_name LIKE '%Operating%' AND attendance_percent < 75

question: Average internal percentage in each of my classes, by subject and section.
gold_sql: SELECT subject_name, section, ROUND(AVG(internal_percent), 2) AS avg_internal FROM my_class_marks GROUP BY subject_name, section

question: How many students are registered in each of my classes?
gold_sql: SELECT subject_name, section, registered_students FROM my_classes

question: How many feedback comments did I get for each rating?
gold_sql: SELECT rating, COUNT(*) AS comments FROM my_class_feedback GROUP BY rating

question: Mere DBMS class mein kitne students ke internal 40% se kam hain?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS students FROM my_class_marks WHERE subject_name LIKE '%Database%' AND internal_percent < 40

question: Which of my advisees have a backlog? Give roll numbers.
gold_sql: SELECT roll_no FROM my_advisees WHERE total_backlogs > 0

question: How many of my advisees have attendance below 75% in at least one subject?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS advisees FROM advisee_attendance WHERE attendance_percent < 75

question: What is the average latest CGPA of my advisees?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(latest_cgpa), 2) AS avg_cgpa FROM my_advisees

question: Subject-wise pass percentage in my department this semester.
gold_sql: SELECT subject_name, ROUND(AVG(internal_pass) * 100, 2) AS pass_percent FROM dept_marks GROUP BY subject_name

question: Average attendance by semester in my department.
gold_sql: SELECT semester, ROUND(AVG(attendance_percent), 2) AS avg_attendance FROM dept_attendance GROUP BY semester

question: How many students are in each semester of my department?
gold_sql: SELECT current_semester, COUNT(*) AS students FROM dept_students GROUP BY current_semester

question: Which faculty member has the lowest average feedback rating in my department?
gold_sql: SELECT faculty_name FROM dept_feedback GROUP BY faculty_name ORDER BY AVG(rating) LIMIT 1

question: Department mein kitne registrations pending hain?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS pending FROM dept_registrations WHERE status = 'pending'

question: In 5th semester DBMS, which section has the lower average internal percentage?
gold_sql: SELECT section FROM dept_marks WHERE semester = 5 AND subject_name LIKE '%Database%' GROUP BY section ORDER BY AVG(internal_percent) LIMIT 1

question: How many CSE students are failing internals in at least one subject?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS students FROM dept_marks WHERE internal_pass = 0

question: Compare pass percentage across all departments this semester.
gold_sql: SELECT dept_code, ROUND(AVG(internal_pass) * 100, 2) AS pass_percent FROM marks GROUP BY dept_code

question: Department-wise pending fees.
gold_sql: SELECT dept_code, SUM(pending) AS total_pending FROM fee_status GROUP BY dept_code

question: How many students have overdue fees in each department?
gold_sql: SELECT dept_code, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS students FROM fee_status WHERE is_overdue = 1 GROUP BY dept_code

question: Average SGPA per department in academic year 2025-26.
gold_sql: SELECT dept_code, ROUND(AVG(sgpa), 2) AS avg_sgpa FROM results WHERE academic_year = '2025-26' GROUP BY dept_code

question: Show the week-by-week average attendance of ECE 3rd semester section B, in date order.
gold_sql: SELECT week_start, ROUND(AVG(attendance_percent), 2) AS attendance_percent FROM attendance_weekly WHERE dept_code = 'ECE' AND semester = 3 AND section = 'B' GROUP BY week_start ORDER BY week_start

question: Sabse zyada pending fees kis department ki hai?
gold_sql: SELECT dept_code FROM fee_status GROUP BY dept_code ORDER BY SUM(pending) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Total fee collected by payment mode.
gold_sql: SELECT mode, SUM(amount_paid) AS collected FROM fee_payments GROUP BY mode

question: Hostel-wise number of students with overdue fees.
gold_sql: SELECT h.hostel_name, COUNT(DISTINCT f.student_id) AS defaulters FROM fee_status f JOIN hostel_allocations h ON h.student_id = f.student_id WHERE h.is_current = 1 AND f.is_overdue = 1 GROUP BY h.hostel_name

question: Which mess got the most hygiene complaints this month?
gold_sql: SELECT mess_name FROM complaint_themes WHERE theme = 'hygiene' AND mess_name IS NOT NULL AND created_on >= '2026-11-01' AND created_on < '2026-12-01' GROUP BY mess_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Compare average SGPA of hostellers vs day scholars by department.
gold_sql: SELECT r.dept_code, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN s.is_hosteller = 1 THEN r.sgpa END), 2) AS hosteller_avg_sgpa, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN s.is_hosteller = 0 THEN r.sgpa END), 2) AS day_scholar_avg_sgpa FROM results r JOIN student_residence s ON s.student_id = r.student_id GROUP BY r.dept_code

question: How many unresolved complaints are there per category?
gold_sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS complaints FROM complaints WHERE status <> 'resolved' GROUP BY category

question: Har hostel mein abhi kitne students rehte hain?
gold_sql: SELECT hostel_name, COUNT(*) AS students FROM hostel_allocations WHERE is_current = 1 GROUP BY hostel_name
